name: Bookmarks' web UI at phone width: a 390x844 touch viewport, where kit.css's phone rules apply that Bookmarks 1.0 didn't have: dialogs as bottom sheets (max-width 40em), icon buttons of at least 40 px (pointer: coarse), and borders in forced-colors mode. Screenshots of the details section, the editor and the player's bookmarks list, with the measurements saved as evidence. Resets the admin's bookmarks on Long Test Movie to two known ones first (sandbox data only).

steps.name: the page sees a narrow touch screen
steps.message: the emulated viewport is not a 390 px touch screen

steps.name: find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: reset the movie's bookmarks to a point at 0:15 ('webcheck') and a range 0:30-0:40 ('webcheck-ui range')
steps.script: const itemId = __vars.movieId; const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } for (const body of [{ ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 150000000, Note: 'webcheck' }, { ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 300000000, EndTicks: 400000000, Note: 'webcheck-ui range' }]) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: url('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))).length;

steps.name: the Bookmarks section lists the two bookmarks
the rows wrap at phone width and their icon buttons are touch-sized
steps.script: const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section .jfbm-row')]; const buttons = rows.flatMap(r => [...r.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-icon-button')]); const sizes = buttons.map(b => { const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)]; }); return { rowWrap: getComputedStyle(rows[0]).flexWrap, sizes, ok: getComputedStyle(rows[0]).flexWrap === 'wrap' && buttons.length >= 4 && sizes.every(([w, h]) => w >= 40 && h >= 40) };

steps.name: details rows as expected
steps.message: the details rows don't wrap or have icon buttons under 40 px

steps.name: open the editor with Add bookmark
the New bookmark editor
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'New bookmark'; })()

steps.name: the editor is a bottom sheet with touch-sized icon buttons
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop'); const p = b.querySelector('.jfbm-panel'); const r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); const cs = getComputedStyle(p); const icons = [...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-icon-button')].filter(i => i.offsetParent !== null).map(i => { const q = i.getBoundingClientRect(); return [i.title, Math.round(q.width), Math.round(q.height)]; }); const m = { alignItems: getComputedStyle(b).alignItems, backdropPadding: getComputedStyle(b).padding, panel: [Math.round(r.left), Math.round(r.top), Math.round(r.right), Math.round(r.bottom)], viewport: [innerWidth, innerHeight], radius: [cs.borderTopLeftRadius, cs.borderTopRightRadius, cs.borderBottomLeftRadius, cs.borderBottomRightRadius], maxHeight: cs.maxHeight, icons }; m.ok = m.alignItems === 'flex-end' && m.backdropPadding === '0px' && m.panel[0] === 0 && m.panel[2] === innerWidth && Math.abs(m.panel[3] - innerHeight) <= 1 && m.radius[2] === '0px' && m.radius[3] === '0px' && m.radius[0] !== '0px' && icons.length >= 2 && icons.every(([, w, h]) => w >= 40 && h >= 40); return m;

steps.name: editor bottom sheet as expected
steps.message: the editor is not a full-width bottom sheet with 40 px icon buttons

steps.name: details page with a Play button
the list dialog with two rows
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'Bookmarks' && p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row').length === 2; })()

steps.name: the player list is a bottom sheet with touch-sized icon buttons
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop'); const p = b.querySelector('.jfbm-panel'); const r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); const cs = getComputedStyle(p); const icons = [...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-icon-button')].filter(i => i.offsetParent !== null).map(i => { const q = i.getBoundingClientRect(); return [i.title, Math.round(q.width), Math.round(q.height)]; }); const m = { alignItems: getComputedStyle(b).alignItems, panel: [Math.round(r.left), Math.round(r.top), Math.round(r.right), Math.round(r.bottom)], viewport: [innerWidth, innerHeight], radius: [cs.borderTopLeftRadius, cs.borderBottomLeftRadius], rowWrap: getComputedStyle(p.querySelector('.jfbm-row')).flexWrap, icons }; m.ok = m.alignItems === 'flex-end' && m.panel[0] === 0 && m.panel[2] === innerWidth && Math.abs(m.panel[3] - innerHeight) <= 1 && m.radius[1] === '0px' && m.rowWrap === 'wrap' && icons.length >= 5 && icons.every(([, w, h]) => w >= 40 && h >= 40); return m;

steps.name: player list bottom sheet as expected
steps.message: the player list is not a full-width bottom sheet with 40 px icon buttons

steps.name: the panel, its buttons and icon buttons have borders
steps.script: const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const width = (el) => getComputedStyle(el).borderTopWidth + ' ' + getComputedStyle(el).borderTopStyle; const m = { forced: matchMedia('(forced-colors: active)').matches, panel: width(p), iconButtons: [...new Set([...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-icon-button')].map(width))] }; m.ok = m.forced && m.panel === '1px solid' && m.iconButtons.length === 1 && m.iconButtons[0] === '1px solid'; return m;
